newsitem.title: USA: US mortgage-backeds flat, seen waiting for FOMC.
newsitem.headline: US mortgage-backeds flat, seen waiting for FOMC.

text.p: U.S. mortgage-backed securities were largely unchanged on Thursday, with yield spreads steady to slightly narrower, traders said.
A consensus developed among economists that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates next week, but that rattled Treasuries more than mortgages.
Short- and medium-term Treasuries were unchanged to off 3/32 in late trading, while mortgages were nearly uniformly flat.
Traders said the action should pick up next Tuesday independent of the result of the Fed policy meeting.
"Everybody's just waiting for something to respond to, whether they hike rates or not," one trader said.
In key coupons, Ginnie Mae 30-year 7.5 percent paper was unchanged at 98-28/32, yielding 98 basis points over the 10-year Treasury note.
Comparable Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac issues were unchanged as well, at 99-00/32 and 99-06/32, respectively.
The 10-year Treasury note was down 4/32 at 96-16/32 to yield 6.74 percent.
The latest Reuters survey showed 34 of 48 economists polled were expecting a credit tightening next week.
